# wallix-bastion_domain_account (Data Source)

Get information on a domain account resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get information about a specific domain account
data "wallix-bastion_domain_account" "admin" {
  domain_id    = wallix-bastion_domain.corporate.id
  account_name = "administrator"
}

# Use the account information to look up its credential
data "wallix-bastion_domain_account_credential" "admin_password" {
  domain_id  = data.wallix-bastion_domain_account.admin.domain_id
  account_id = data.wallix-bastion_domain_account.admin.id
  type       = "password"
}

# Output account configuration
output "admin_account_info" {
  value = {
    id                    = data.wallix-bastion_domain_account.admin.id
    account_login         = data.wallix-bastion_domain_account.admin.account_login
    auto_change_password  = data.wallix-bastion_domain_account.admin.auto_change_password
    checkout_policy       = data.wallix-bastion_domain_account.admin.checkout_policy
    resources             = data.wallix-bastion_domain_account.admin.resources
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `domain_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `account_login` (String)
- `auto_change_password` (Boolean)
- `auto_change_ssh_key` (Boolean)
- `certificate_validity` (String)
- `checkout_policy` (String)
- `credentials` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `description` (String)
- `domain_password_change` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `resources` (Set of String)

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>

### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
- `type` (String)

## Usage Notes

### Lookup Keys

This data source requires two keys to locate the account:

- **domain_id**: The internal ID of the parent domain (`wallix-bastion_domain`)
- **account_name**: The name of the account within that domain

### Resources

The `resources` attribute lists the device services and/or applications this account can access, in the form `device:<service>` or `application:<name>` (for example `"device:ssh"`, `"application:erp"`).

### Credentials

The `credentials` attribute returns a list of associated credential entries (`id`, `type`, `public_key`), but never returns secret material. Use `wallix-bastion_domain_account_credential` with the account `id` to check credential metadata; secret values are never exposed through either data source.

### Prerequisites

The referenced domain must already exist (`wallix-bastion_domain`), and the account must have been created on it (`wallix-bastion_domain_account`) before it can be looked up.
